items.title: Google AI Studio 'Delete' is a scam: Your prompts are not deleted, just hidden

title_i18n.en: Google AI Studio 'Delete' is a scam: Your prompts are not deleted, just hidden

title_i18n.es: La opción Eliminar de Google AI Studio es una estafa: tus prompts no se eliminan, solo se ocultan.

excerpt_i18n.en: A Medium post claims that Google AI Studio's "Delete" function does not actually remove prompts, but merely hides them from the user interface. The author warns users not to assume that sensitive inputs are truly erased from the platform.
excerpt_i18n.zh: 一篇发布于 Medium 的文章指控 Google AI Studio 的“删除”功能名不副实：用户执行删除操作后，提示词（prompts）实际上并未被真正清除，而只是从前端界面中被隐藏起来。作者由此提醒用户，不要误以为敏感或私密的输入内容已从平台上彻底移除。

items.title: GGG – A local-first, zero-telemetry sovereign proxy daemon for AI tools
items.raw_excerpt: GGG (garza-global-graviton) is a local-first proxy daemon for AI tools that emphasizes zero telemetry and user data sovereignty. By intercepting and routing AI tool requests locally, it aims to keep usage data under the user's own control rather than exposing it to third parties.

excerpt_i18n.zh: GGG（garza-global-graviton）是一个面向 AI 工具的本地优先代理守护进程，主打零遥测与数据主权。它通过在本地拦截和转发 AI 工具的请求，让用户自行掌控流量走向，避免使用数据被第三方收集。项目源码托管在 GitHub 上。
